maria: Heads-up from sales: BigCorp says tenant routing + full SSO must be in v1 or they'll delay onboarding.
kevin: Full SSO meaning OIDC + SCIM + audit exports?
maria: Yep. They want GA in early June.
jess: Our public v1 target is mid-July. Early June is a hard shift.
raj: If we accelerate SSO, we need to cut something. What are tradeoffs?
tara: Promo widgets and extended analytics retention are the least-customer-facing pieces. Could bump them to v1.1.
kevin: Technical reality: SCIM testing matrix is the slow item. OIDC + audit exports could be a fast follow canary.
maria: Suggestion for negotiation: offer OIDC + audit export canary for early June (feature-flagged), commit to SCIM GA by v1 (mid-July).
jess: That reduces immediate risk and gives sales breathing room. We'll need two engineers diverted for 4	6 weeks.
raj: Also legal needs SLA language; that often adds time.
maria: Action: I'll confirm canary acceptance with BigCorp. kevin -> canary infra plan by Friday; jess -> PRD for scoped canary; tara -> list of cuts to push to v1.1.
deploy-bot: Created SSO-5501 "sso-canary-scope"  https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SSO-5501
maria: Recording decision here: OIDC-canary for early June, SCIM GA in v1 mid-July, promo widgets + retention -> v1.1. Risks: SLA negotiation, SCIM edge cases.
kevin: ack
jess: ack
raj: ack
